name: Hide & Sneak
desc:
✨Players are divided into two teams: the props and the Seekers. The props must blend in with their surroundings by turning into objects, while the Seekers must find and eliminate all the props within the time limit! ✨

💎 Earn Cash & Wins to unlock powerups to use as a Seeker, and various other fun cosmetics! 🤩

👍 Be sure to like and favorite this game for more updates! ⭐

Tags: Hide and Seek, Disguise, Prop, Hunt, Sneak, Find, Adventure, Puzzle, Teamwork, Extreme, Ultimate, Tag, Round, Seeker, Hiding, Taunt
